iterations.strategy: Category A — Plan restructuring. Root cause: iter_0 crashed (SIGSEGV) due to buffer overflow in composite key computation. The formula (stmt_code << 8) | rfile_code produces values up to 2049 (stmt has 9 dictionary codes 0-8), but only 256 array slots were allocated. Fix: use composite_key = stmt_code * num_rfile + rfile_code, giving max 9*2=18 groups. Allocate array sized to num_stmt * num_rfile at runtime. This also reduces per-thread memory from 2.76MB to 194KB (18 vs 256 groups), improving cache locality. Retained from iter_0: demand-paged mmap with MADV_SEQUENTIAL + MADV_HUGEPAGE, no MAP_POPULATE, schedule(static), no Kahan summation, mmap declared before RAII timer scope, per-group bitset for COUNT(DISTINCT adsh). For adsh dict, only read the uint32_t count from the first 4 bytes — no need to decode all 86K strings.
